vopros: What do you know about Vita Kamliuk, a real estate agent in Los Angeles? Which brokerage is she with?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Vita Kamliuk is currently a real estate agent with Compass in Los Angeles. Compass’s own agent directory lists her as a REALTOR® under California DRE license #02166055, with specialties including buyer representation, listings, relocation, and property management. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

Her current professional materials say she works throughout Greater Los Angeles, with particular emphasis on the San Fernando Valley and Westside — including Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Studio City, Tarzana, Westlake Village, Westwood, Beverly Hills, and West Hollywood. She speaks English and Russian. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

Her background is somewhat unusual for an LA residential agent. According to her bio, she previously worked in commercial real estate internationally, including positions with Knight Frank and Colliers International, before moving into residential real estate in California. Her website claims roughly 18 years of industry experience and involvement in more than 500 transactions over her broader career. Those career figures are self-reported rather than independently verified here. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

She was previously affiliated with Keller Williams: a 2022 VoyageLA profile identified her as working from the Keller Williams Beverly Hills office. That information is now outdated. Her current Compass profile, current website, LinkedIn presence, and recent 2026 posts all identify her with Compass. ([voyagela.com](https://voyagela.com/interview/exploring-life-business-with-vita-kamliuk-of-keller-williams/?utm_source=openai))

So, as of September 2026: Vita Kamliuk → Compass, DRE #02166055. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

If you're considering hiring her, I can also look into her recent listings/sales, transaction history, reviews, licensing record, and how her track record compares with other LA agents.
